sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), English. The host is not reachable from the build machine, so the text was read from the repo's own snapshot of the wiki pages (the .github/wiki folder: the attribute pages and the spell pages, intro and description) and from the search summaries of the live pages. Quoted facts are the wiki's; nothing was invented.
sources.design: Order and thresholds of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs and the strength of the spell: the sources give no chapter or episode for them. See docs/magic/character_spells_rest.md.

spells.name: Dream Magic (a drowsy haze)
spells.note: Mode 0 of the Dream book; the magic's trait is drowsiness.

spells.name: Dream Magic (a dream world under her control)
spells.note: Search summaries of the Dream Magic page: she creates a dream-like world over which she has full control.

spells.name: Dream Magic (imagination made real in the dream)
spells.note: Design: what she builds inside the dream world.

spells.name: Dream Magic: Glamour World
spells.note: A multi-hued mist pulls whatever it touches into a dream world; those inside grow drowsier and die if they fall asleep there.

spells.name: Dream Magic: Drowsy Mist
spells.note: Her dream makes everyone in it drowsy (the wiki names drowsiness as the trait of Dream Magic).

spells.name: Dream Magic: Counting Sheep
spells.note: Design: a sleepy page of the shared Dream book.

spells.name: Dream Magic: Pillow Burst
spells.note: Design: a sleepy page of the shared Dream book.

spells.name: Dream Magic: Lucid Step
spells.note: Design: walking through her own dream.

spells.name: Dream Magic: Dreamcatcher Ward
spells.note: Design: a ward against bad dreams for her allies.

spells.name: Dream Magic: Mind Read
spells.note: Her mind reading lets her manifest the thoughts of her opponents inside the dream (character guides quoting the wiki).

spells.name: Dream Magic: Nightmare Seed
spells.note: Design: a bad dream planted where she aims.

spells.name: Dream Magic: Slumber Field
spells.note: Design: a field of dream mist.

spells.name: Dream Magic: Pastel Garden
spells.note: Design: what she imagines into being inside the dream, a garden of sweets.

spells.name: Dream Magic: Sleepwalker
spells.note: Design: Dorothy is always asleep; she walks on unnoticed.

spells.name: Dream Magic: Eternal Slumber
spells.note: Design: the whole room falls asleep for good, the finishing page after Glamour World.

notes: Glamour World is the only Dream spell the sources name for her. Not in her grimoire (kept in the basic Dream book): Sweet Dream is this mod's own page and was not found in any source for Dorothy. Pages 15 (batch 3): the entries after the first ones are the new shared pages of the book (and some older pages of it), none exclusive, so the basic grimoire keeps showing them too.
